name: International Studies
about: An interdisciplinary programme combining economics, political science, business, history and law around global issues. All courses are taught in English in small classes, with optional certificate tracks such as International Business and Economics.

name: Global Korean Studies
about: Korean studies from a global perspective in Scranton College, set up in 2015, leading to a Bachelor of Arts in Global Korean Studies. The admissions guide says all major courses are taught in English.

name: Undergraduate entry (major chosen in year two)
about: You enter KAIST without declaring a major and explore STEM fields in year one, then choose a department from the natural sciences, life science, engineering, AI and business colleges with no extra admission step.

name: International Studies (English Track)
about: An all-English curriculum in the Division of International Studies with five specialisations: International Commerce, International Development and Cooperation, International Peace and Security, Area Studies and Korean Studies.

name: Undergraduate School (undeclared major)
about: International admits enter the Mueunjae School of Undergraduate Studies, then move into a department: mathematics, physics, chemistry, life sciences, or an engineering department such as materials, mechanical, electrical, computer science or chemical.

name: Human Science and Society
about: An English-track interdisciplinary major in the College of Social Sciences that pairs social science with AI, data analytics and language processing, then applies them in electives on governance, the economy, and education and communication.

name: Chemical Engineering
about: SKKU's chemical engineering school covers bio and environmental technology, materials and related areas on the Suwon campus. Admitted through the Engineering English Track, you move into your chosen major in year two.

name: Advanced Materials Science and Engineering
about: A materials engineering department on the Suwon campus, accredited by the Korean engineering accreditation board ABEEK since 2007. Admitted through the Engineering English Track, you enter the major you applied to in year two.

name: Mechanical Engineering
about: The School of Mechanical Engineering joins departments founded in 1966 and 1978 and teaches multidisciplinary mechanical engineering on the Suwon campus. Admitted through the Engineering English Track, you enter this major in year two.

name: Nano Engineering
about: A department set up in 2018 around nano-fabrication and its fusion with other fields, teaching nanomaterials, nanodevices and nanoprocesses from theory at the nanoscale to practical use. It is based on the Suwon campus.

name: Computer Science and Engineering
about: Core computer science with an emphasis on convergence, mandatory team projects from the third semester, an industry or lab internship requirement and a 10,000 Line Project on open-source software, on the Suwon campus.

name: Underwood Division
about: UIC's founding division, set up in 2005, with a common curriculum on reasoning and communication and five majors: Comparative Literature and Culture, Economics, International Studies, Political Science and International Relations, and Life Science and Biotechnology.

name: Humanities, Arts and Social Sciences Division
about: Eight majors: Asian Studies, Culture and Design Management, Information and Interaction Design, Creative Technology Management, Justice and Civil Leadership, Quantitative Risk Management, Science, Technology and Policy, Sustainable Development and Cooperation.

name: Integrated Science and Engineering Division
about: Three science and engineering majors built on an interdisciplinary curriculum: Nano Science and Engineering, Energy and Environmental Science and Engineering, and Bio-Convergence, with experiment-based coursework.

name: Commerce
about: A flexible business degree where you study one major (accounting, finance, international business, logistics and supply chain, management or marketing) or a double major; the school holds AACSB accreditation.

name: Computing (Cyber Security)
about: Computing degree that starts from programming in C and Java and Linux skills, then specialises in cyber security: cryptography, access policy, computer forensics and intrusion detection.

name: Information Technology
about: Covers programming (in Python), computer networks and security, specialising in distributed computing, with Linux skills taught from the basics upward.

name: Computer Science in Real-Time Interactive Simulation
about: A software engineering degree built on mathematics, physics and computer science, where you design and program full projects, from graphical algorithms to physics engines and level editors.

name: Computer Science in Interactive Media and Game Development
about: A hybrid programmer-designer degree: C and C++ programming, game logic, user interfaces and AI, tested across PC, mobile, console, VR and AR platforms through many individual and team projects.

name: User Experience and Game Design
about: A multidisciplinary degree joining user experience design theory with the humanities and social sciences, building AR and VR applications and interfaces through research, user testing and rapid prototyping.

name: Global BBA
about: A four-year management degree whose first cycle covers the fundamentals of management; you choose the English Track in Singapore for year 1, and later study at least six months abroad at a partner university.

name: Business
about: A two-year business degree with a core of accounting, economics, data analysis, management, marketing and law, ending in a work-integrated capstone; majors are available for specialising.

name: Business
about: Business degree that pairs tourist behaviour and destination management with the operations of hospitality businesses, aimed at international careers in the industry.

name: Business
about: Business degree on how multinational companies are developed and managed, as globalisation and communication technology push more firms across borders.

name: Business
about: Business degree on motivating staff, raising productivity, employment relations and healthy workplaces; this major is accredited by the Australian HR Institute.

name: Business
about: Business degree for a career in managing a business or starting your own, set against fast technological change and global competition.

name: Business
about: Business degree on how firms run critical processes on IT and reach clients and staff electronically, joining business knowledge with information systems.

name: Business
about: Business degree covering product research, consumer demand, pricing and customer communication, including digital marketing and social media.

name: Commerce
about: A two-year commerce degree for business and not-for-profit careers: a business core first, then a major, with industry projects and an ethical, commercial mindset.

name: Commerce
about: Commerce degree with an accounting major after the shared business core, preparing you for accounting careers in business and not-for-profit settings.

name: Commerce
about: Commerce degree with a banking and finance major after the shared business core, preparing you for careers in banks and financial firms.

name: Commerce
about: Commerce degree with an economics major after the shared business core, applying economic reasoning to business and not-for-profit decisions.

name: Commerce
about: Commerce degree with a financial management major after the shared business core, on managing money inside organisations.

name: Commerce
about: Commerce degree with an international trade major after the shared business core, on how goods and services move across borders.

name: Business and Environmental Science
credential: Bachelor of Business and Environmental Science
about: Joins business with environmental science, because firms need strategies on carbon footprint, sustainable practice, climate change and waste.

name: Business and Environmental Science
credential: Bachelor of Business and Environmental Science
about: Business and environmental science with an aquaculture major: the biological knowledge needed to raise fish, prawns and algae, alongside a business plan.

name: Psychology Studies
about: A Bachelor of Arts with a psychology major on the biological, social and cultural factors behind how people think, feel and behave, to combine with another area of study.

name: Psychological Science
about: A science-based psychology degree on how people think, feel and behave, with a core psychology programme and electives; it is accredited by the Australian Psychology Accreditation Council.

name: Data Science
about: A science degree majoring in data science, on the big data, algorithms and analytics that industries from defence to finance now depend on.

name: Aquaculture Science and Technology
about: A science degree on breeding, rearing and harvesting fish, shellfish and aquatic plants for a secure food supply and the protection of wild species.

name: Cybersecurity
about: A cybersecurity degree for a field short of specialists, with relevance to the Internet of Things and critical infrastructure across the ASEAN region.

name: Information Technology
about: An IT degree with interactive visualisation, games, big data and data mining, 2D and 3D graphics, web and mobile technologies, and programming and design thinking.

name: Economics
about: An economics degree on the links between individuals, businesses and nations, using data analysis and theory to design sustainable economic policy.

name: Tourism, Hospitality and Events
credential: Bachelor of Tourism, Hospitality and Events
about: Prepares you to manage tourism, hospitality and event businesses, with supervisory and managerial skills and research and presentation skills.

name: Acting
about: A conservatory-style acting degree training actors in acting, voice and movement techniques such as mime, silat, Suzuki, biomechanics or Le Jeu, with theory and research tied to performance.

name: Animation Art
about: Animation study at the Puttnam School of Film and Animation, where short films, documentaries and animation are made inside a wider creative arts environment.

name: Art Histories and Curatorial Practices: Asia and the World
about: Joins art history and curatorial practice rather than treating them as separate disciplines, with a regional focus on Asia and the world.

name: Arts Management
about: Covers contemporary issues and policy shaping the creative sector and arts markets, building leadership, business, communication and managerial skills for the arts and cultural industries.

name: Design Communication
about: A visual communication degree about how design shapes everyday communication, preparing you to contribute to contemporary visual culture, social practice and the new economy.

name: Design for Social Futures
about: Builds flexibility in leadership, co-creation and collaboration through service design, user-interface and user-experience design, data, social design and speculative and strategic design.

name: Fashion Design and Textiles
about: Focuses on designing and constructing the fashion garment, with craftsmanship, sustainability and sociocultural questions, in practical workshops and industry projects.

name: Fashion Media and Industries
about: A multidisciplinary degree in fashion media and communication and in fashion entrepreneurship, built for the new creative roles emerging in the fashion industry.

name: Film
about: Develops you as a total filmmaker, from script to screen, with a high level of technical and narrative artistry and a focus on your own authorship.

name: Fine Arts
about: Contemporary fine art practice from traditional disciplines to emergent art forms, built around debate, questioning conventions and a wide choice of ways to express yourself.

name: Interior Design
about: Designs spaces and experiential environments from human behaviour and emotion, drawing on architecture, lighting, furniture and exhibition design and working with industry professionals.

name: International Contemporary Dance Practices
about: Develops independent, experimental dance artists across Singapore and London, with visiting international artists and performance in live and digital contexts.

name: Music
about: Contemporary music study with five specialist areas: popular music performance, electronic music, jazz performance, composition and arranging, and classical performance.

name: Music Business
about: Prepares you to lead in the global music industry, from launching artistes and marketing campaigns to producing and distributing music, with flexible electives.

name: Musical Theatre
about: Trains performers for musical theatre, an art form where gifted, highly trained performers sit alongside directors, choreographers, designers and musicians.

name: Product Design
about: Develops designers of tangible and intangible products through design research, analytical thinking and empathy, working across sectors and disciplines.

name: Biophilic Design
about: Spatial design that joins nature, sustainability and human well-being, with a focus on regenerative futures, ecological thinking and Southeast Asian environmental contexts.

name: Design Practice
about: A studio-based design degree where you specialise in 3-dimensional, communication, fashion or spatial design, with a five-week international placement in the second year.

name: Fine Art
about: An immersive studio degree across traditional and contemporary media, built on experimentation, critical enquiry and Southeast Asian perspectives.

name: Performance Making
about: Pre-professional training in dance or theatre combined with interdisciplinary performance making, studio practice and professional productions.

name: Instrumental & Vocal Teaching
about: Prepares performer-educators through one-to-one tuition, ensembles, teaching practicum and mentorship, and technology-enabled teaching.

name: Music
about: A four-year conservatoire degree with one-to-one principal study and pathways in performance, technology, research, or theory and composition, with placements in London and Beijing.

name: Materials Engineering
about: A four-year engineering degree that combines the fundamental sciences with engineering; strong students can be offered an accelerated 3.5-year route after first year.

name: Business
about: A four-year business degree at Nanyang Business School designed for depth, breadth, flexibility and global exposure, with minors and second majors such as Entrepreneurship.

name: Computer Science
about: A project-based computing degree with a wide spread of electives, from big data and full-stack software engineering to artificial intelligence and robotics; double degrees, double majors and minors are open to you.

name: Communication
about: A University at Buffalo degree taught at SIM on interpersonal communication with an international focus, covering mass media, organisational and mediated communication and intercultural communication.

name: Marketing
about: A University of Stirling marketing degree taught at SIM with a digital focus, practising on industry platforms such as Google Analytics and HubSpot; accredited by the Chartered Institute of Marketing.

name: Diagnostic Radiography
about: A four-year direct honours degree that trains you to produce and interpret medical images (X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, nuclear medicine), with at least 1,000 hours of clinical placements.

name: Food Technology
credential: Bachelor of Food Technology with Honours
about: A four-year direct honours degree that joins food science, food engineering, design and business, with lab work on industrial food-processing equipment and an 8 to 12 month work placement.

name: Business Management
about: A business degree at the Lee Kong Chian School of Business built on ten majors, from Finance and Marketing to Digital Business and Sustainability, taught in small interactive classes with a guaranteed second major.

name: Accountancy
about: A broad-based degree with a strong accounting core that adds business, data analytics, digital technology and sustainability; the school is accredited by ten professional and educational bodies.

name: Law
about: A law degree at the Yong Pung How School of Law in the city centre, taught in seminars, with international moots, exchange and internships, and law-related electives that put the subject in context.

name: Accountancy
about: Trains you as an accountant through accounting, assurance and attestation, law, taxation and information technology, with general business knowledge alongside.

name: Early Childhood Education
about: A multi-disciplinary degree for working with young children; open to applicants with or without an ECE diploma. IB Diploma holders take the four-year track.

name: Human Resource Management
about: Prepares you as a specialist HR practitioner, treating human resources as part of corporate and business strategy rather than a support function.

name: Public Safety and Security
credential: Bachelor of Public Safety and Security
about: A four-year degree that professionalises public safety and security, from terrorism to cybercrime, with courses such as the psychological perspective to public safety.

name: Business Analytics
credential: Bachelor of Science in Business Analytics
about: A four-year direct honours degree of 200 credit units that adds statistics and analytics to the SUSS Core, with a 24-week work attachment.

name: Finance
about: A four-year direct honours degree of 200 credit units in finance, with a 24-week work attachment, an overseas experience and a community engagement.

name: Information and Communication Technology
about: A four-year full-time degree covering computer science foundations, software and application development and networking, with maths electives such as statistics and cryptography.

name: Marketing
about: An applied marketing degree drawing on psychology, economics and statistics to decide what to sell, at what price and to whom, on a broad business base.

name: Psychology
about: A broad degree in theoretical, conceptual and analytical skills in psychology, with electives such as work psychology and health psychology and well-being.

name: Supply Chain Management
about: Built with the Singapore Logistics Association to prepare supply chain talent for Singapore and Southeast Asia, with critical thinking and decision-making skills.

name: Social Work
about: A degree giving the knowledge, skills and values for a social work career in Singapore, with an emphasis on equity and inclusion.

name: Architecture and Sustainable Design
about: A digital-era architecture degree built around the design studio sequence, with core subjects in design computation, building technology and history, theory and culture, ending in a capstone and option studios.

name: Computer Science and Design
about: A computing-intensive engineering degree under the ISTD pillar: a 60-credit computer science core, electives and tracks such as AI, data analytics, security and software engineering, plus humanities and social sciences.

name: Design and Artificial Intelligence
about: Combines AI with an understanding of people, business and society to design human-centred solutions; the 2026 curriculum is open to students from science, non-science and hybrid backgrounds.

name: Engineering Product Development
about: Design and build intelligent products that sense, think and act in the real world, learning through hands-on projects from day one, with AI woven into the courses rather than a separate track.

name: Engineering Systems and Design
about: Model, analyse and optimise large-scale systems such as transport and supply chains; an 84-credit core of methods courses, then electives or a track such as aviation systems or financial services.
